glycine.declared: two independent replicates, analyzed separately then merged and normalized (RDAT COMMENT line 16)
glycine.merge_point: upstream ShapeMapper2; per-replicate counts not stored in archive
glycine.rationale: the single merged normalized reactivity profile was used both to select strong probes (probe selection) and to determine n (post-selection); no replicate is a cold held-out replicate

add/miniTTR.declared: single RDAT with per-position REACTIVITY_ERROR:1/2 (standard errors)
add/miniTTR.notes: per-position standard error is parsed and output but NOT used in the clamp likelihood; provenance per_position_error_used=True is a false claim

raw_count_replay.detail: No RDAT field (MUTATION/COUNTS/REPLICATE/READS/COVERAGE) carries per-replicate raw counts; only merged normalized reactivity is present. Raw-count replay cannot be executed for any of the three measured cases.

qualification_verdict.reason: the candidate archive does not contain per-replicate raw counts, so the replicate crosswalk and raw-count replay prerequisites cannot be satisfied; the kill test cannot be run against real replicate counts
qualification_verdict.downgrade_detail: add/miniTTR n=3, glycine n=15, SAM-III n=3 are demoted from experimental sample-size conclusions to arbitrary-clamp model output (provenance per_position_error_used=False); a future upgrade requires an unexposed multi-unit sealed confirmation set per audit §9.4 and §13.1 P0-5 success criteria
